title_en: Oni Press' Sabrina the Teenage Witch Reboot Kicks Off a Major New Storyline Called 'Needles & Pins' in February 2027
summary_en: Oni Press' Sabrina the Teenage Witch reboot is one of our favorite new comics of 2026, and we've got an exclusive first look at the series' next major storyline.
body_en:
Oni Press' recent Sabrina the Teenage Witch series is shaping up nicely. In fact, we found it to be the best of Oni and Archie Comics' recent Archie reboots . Oni is teasing a fresh jumping-on point and the start of a major new storyline called "Needles & Pins" with the release of Sabrina the Teenage Witch #5 in February 2027.
IGN can exclusively reveal the cover art to Sabrina the Teenage Witch #5. Check it out in the slideshow gallery below:
Sabrina the Teenage Witch is written by Corinna Bechko, with art by Kano and Jordan Chase. The issue features covers by Marguerite Sauvage, Travis Charest, Oliver Barrett, Evgenia Vereli, and Dan Parent.
Here's the official solicitation text for Sabrina the Teenage Witch #5:
Sabrina the Teenage Witch #5 will be released on February 17. You can preorder a copy at your local comic shop .
In IGN's review of Sabrina the Teenage Witch #1 , we wrote, "If Archie #1 is guilty of playing things a little too safe and traditional, that’s not a problem for this reboot of its sister series. This is easily the most satisfying debut issue of the trio, one that strikes a nice balance between honoring the franchise’s wholesome, all-ages roots and embracing the possibilities of this new future."
In other Archie news, the horror series Afterlife With Archie is getting rereleased as a "Mausoleum Edition" hardcover .
Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .
